items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Item timeline in SVG + CSS without chart dependencies: TimelineGraph (time axis, lanes, bars and instant markers, dependency arrows, now line, zoom, keyboard navigation in time order, real table view) and a vertical Timeline event list with info/success/warn/danger status.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Pure SVG and CSS. TimelineGraph needs a label; dates accept Date, ISO string or epoch ms; locale defaults to ko-KR. Set lang on the wrapper for CJK leading.
